# Phase 3 evaluation (generated by topo/eval.py)

Meta: `{"baseline": "topo/boutique_baseline.yaml", "baselines_only": true, "corpus_seed": 0, "per_family": 8, "epochs": 40, "seeds": [42, 7, 13, 99, 2024], "snapshots": 5760, "size_small": 9, "size_test_min": 16, "torch": "2.14.1+cpu", "elapsed_s": 13}`

Mean over folds; ± is the std over seeds of the fold-mean (0 for the deterministic rule and p95 baselines).
Protocols `family` and `size` are SYNTHETIC. `real` is the real Bookinfo data, but the simulator was calibrated on it, so it is optimistic. `boutique*` is real Online Boutique data (load-generated traffic with faults WE injected) that the simulator was NOT calibrated on.

## Adoption rule (agreed in advance)
GNN is adopted only if it beats both the MLP and the rule on AP and RC@1 on the held-out synthetic protocols by more than the seed spread.
